entities.summary: Adrian Tadeusz Zandberg is a Polish left-wing politician, computer programmer, and doctor of history, who has served as member of the Sejm since 2019. He is a founding member and co-leader of Partia Razem. He was the party's candidate in the 2025 Polish presidential election.
